stats.label: Placed store equipment
stats.description: Successfully placed a store asset in a measured store; excludes forced restoration and guest placement.

stats.label: Measured-store accounts
stats.description: Accounts playing a Standard store created with Observatory v1; includes returning players creating new stores.

stats.label: Existing-save accounts
stats.description: Accounts playing an older Standard save; may overlap measured-store accounts.

stats.label: Accepted setup introduction
stats.description: Accepted the introduction in a measured store. May later skip.

stats.label: Skipped tutorials
stats.description: Explicitly skipped tutorials in a measured store; not inferred from completion flags.

stats.label: Placed an order
stats.description: Successfully submitted an order in a measured store.

stats.label: Stocked a shelf
stats.description: Successfully stocked a product in a measured store.

stats.label: Set a shelf price
stats.description: Successfully saved a shelf price in a measured store.

stats.label: Opened the store
stats.description: Successfully opened a measured store for business.

stats.label: Completed a first sale
stats.description: Recorded a product sale in a measured store.

stats.label: Completed one played day
stats.description: Completed at least one non-skipped day in a measured store.

stats.label: Completed three played days
stats.description: Completed at least three distinct non-skipped days in one measured store.

stats.label: Completed seven played days
stats.description: Completed at least seven distinct non-skipped days in one measured store.

stats.label: Returned in another launch
stats.description: Played a measured store in at least two application launches; not calendar-day retention.

stats.label: Measured gameplay launches
stats.description: At most once per application launch after a measured Standard store loads.

stats.label: Accounts with a measured first-sale time
stats.description: First sale observed with a valid measured-store active clock. Best observed store-start result per account.

stats.label: First sale within 5 active minutes
stats.description: Cumulative threshold: at least one measured store achieved its first sale within 5 active minutes. Account may appear in multiple thresholds.

stats.label: First sale within 15 active minutes
stats.description: Cumulative threshold: at least one measured store achieved its first sale within 15 active minutes. Account may appear in multiple thresholds.

stats.label: First sale within 30 active minutes
stats.description: Cumulative threshold: at least one measured store achieved its first sale within 30 active minutes. Account may appear in multiple thresholds.

stats.label: First sale within 60 active minutes
stats.description: Cumulative threshold: at least one measured store achieved its first sale within 60 active minutes. Account may appear in multiple thresholds.

stats.label: First sale within 120 active minutes
stats.description: Cumulative threshold: at least one measured store achieved its first sale within 120 active minutes. Account may appear in multiple thresholds.

stats.label: Multiplayer participants
stats.description: Accounts reaching a playable visit as host or guest.

stats.label: Successful host accounts
stats.description: Accounts reaching a playable visit as host.

stats.label: Successful guest accounts
stats.description: Accounts reaching a playable visit as guest.

stats.label: Repeat multiplayer accounts
stats.description: Accounts reaching at least two playable visits; host and guest roles combined.

stats.label: Host attempts
stats.description: Explicit host requests, including local preparation failures.

stats.label: Hosted lobbies available
stats.description: Host network startup succeeded; does not imply a guest joined.

stats.label: Host startup failures
stats.description: Host request failed before network hosting became available.

stats.label: Join attempts
stats.description: Explicit guest join requests. Internal state transitions do not add attempts.

stats.label: Guest peer connections
stats.description: Guest attempts that reached the peer-connected phase.

stats.label: Playable hosted visits
stats.description: Host-side ready visits after snapshot and delta catch-up. One count per connected visit.

stats.label: Playable guest visits
stats.description: Guest-side ready visits after snapshot and delta catch-up. Count separately from host visits.

stats.label: Participant visits
stats.description: Ready host plus guest participations; not unique shared sessions.

stats.label: Invitations dispatched
stats.description: Successful explicit in-game invitation dispatches; excludes Steam overlay invites.

stats.label: Invitation dispatch failures
stats.description: Failed explicit in-game invitation dispatches.

stats.label: Join failures: preparation
stats.description: Failure before lobby travel or local setup failure.

stats.label: Join failures: lobby
stats.description: Lobby failure before peer connection.

stats.label: Join failures: compatibility
stats.description: A known compatibility rejection.

stats.label: Join failures: network
stats.description: Network start or disconnect before playable readiness.

stats.label: Join failures: world loading
stats.description: Snapshot, world load or delta catch-up failed before readiness.

stats.label: Join failures: timeout
stats.description: Guest travel watchdog timed out before readiness.

stats.label: Join attempts cancelled
stats.description: Local leave before playable readiness.

stats.label: Join attempts interrupted
stats.description: A pending guest attempt recovered on a later process launch.

stats.label: Visits ended locally
stats.description: Ready participant chose Leave, ended hosted world, or quit normally.

stats.label: Visits ended by remote disconnect
stats.description: Remote disconnect observed; transport does not establish intent.

stats.label: Visits ended by world failure
stats.description: Snapshot/delta world error after readiness.

stats.label: Visits interrupted
stats.description: Ready participant state recovered after an unclean exit; only checkpointed duration retained.

stats.label: Host playable connected time
stats.description: Sampled unscaled connected seconds after readiness; includes in-game menus and pauses, excludes long suspended frames.

stats.label: Guest playable connected time
stats.description: Sampled unscaled connected seconds after readiness; includes in-game menus and pauses, excludes long suspended frames.

stats.label: Host visits: under 5 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Host visits: 5–15 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Host visits: 15–30 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Host visits: 30–60 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Host visits: 60+ min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Guest visits: under 5 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Guest visits: 5–15 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Guest visits: 15–30 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Guest visits: 30–60 min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.

stats.label: Guest visits: 60+ min
stats.description: One duration bucket on visit ending or recovery. Open visits excluded; interrupted visits use last checkpoint.
